name: Banh tet
summary: One of the cakes made in the Mỹ Phong noodle village, alongside its hủ tiếu, bánh ít, bánh hỏi, and bánh tầm.
howToEat: Look for it on a visit to the Mỹ Phong noodle village.
where: Ấp Hội Gia and ấp Mỹ Hòa in phường Mỹ Phong, and old phường 9, where the noodle yards open 07:00–18:00.
seoDescription: Bánh tét from the Mỹ Phong noodle village, made alongside its hủ tiếu, bánh ít, bánh hỏi, and bánh tầm.
